identification: Carved wooden seated Buddha, bhumisparsha mudra, gilt over red lacquer, flame ushnisha, on stepped red-lacquered plinth (roughly 50-60 cm overall by scale of plinth). Burmese Shan / Thai style. Most likely 20th century decorative export piece; true 18th/19th century Shan examples are carved differently (often dry lacquer, finer detail). Age cannot be confirmed from one photo.

viewing_check: Check weight and wood (light and uniform suggests modern export carving), carving crispness, whether lacquer is real layered thitsi with cloth or a modern paint coat, whether gilding is gold leaf or gold paint, inscriptions or stickers underneath, wood age cracking, any insect holes or old repairs; photograph back, base and the plinth join, and measure height.
